one_month_reasoning: No Synopsys earnings in the window (Q4 FY26 report expected early December). The big scheduled event, the 30 Sep investor day (FY27 guide of $19.04-19.12 non-GAAP EPS vs ~$17.69 Street, Amazon IP deal, GPT-Synopsys, ~$1B buyback), has already happened and the stock rose 12.8% on 1 Oct. In-window chain events: TSMC Q3 results (mid-Oct, likely strong given its raised guide and capex), hyperscaler Q3 capex prints (late Oct), and Cadence Q3 results (est. 26 Oct; record $8.1B backlog, raised guide, so a read-across that is probably supportive). Short-horizon forces offset each other: upward estimate revisions after a guidance beat and a near-term $1B buyback argue for positive drift, while partial reversal after a +12.8% gap day pulls the other way. I set the median slightly above spot (~$494) with ~12% monthly sigma (45% annual / 3.5, a little trimmed), roughly symmetric in log terms.

fair_value.method: Blend of FY28E P/E (EPS $23.0 x 25x = $575, 50%), FY28E FCF yield ($20/sh at 3.6% = $556, 30%) and FY28E EV/sales (8.5x $12.7B less ~$5.7B net debt = $537, 20%), which gives about $562 as of Oct 2027 when the market will be pricing FY28.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: FY28E non-GAAP EPS $23.0 (FY27 guide $19.08 x ~1.20) x 25x NTM

inputs_detail.derivation: Management's long-term model calls for mid-20s% EPS CAGR; I haircut it to ~20% for FY28 because of the 2025 guidance miss (src 18). Industry growth (ESD +12.7%, Cadence guiding +19%, Siemens EDA +30%) supports mid-teens revenue.

SNPS trades at ~27.9x forward / 25.7x FY27 guide versus Cadence at ~40.8x forward. I keep a discount to CDNS for Ansys leverage, IP volatility and the bigger exposure to China and Intel, and assume modest de-rating as growth normalises.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY28E FCF ~$3.8B / ~190M shares = $20/sh at a 3.6% FCF yield

inputs_detail.derivation: FY27 $3.1B grown ~22%, below the mid-20s% long-term FCF growth target.
FY27 guide of 190-192M, with buybacks of up to 50% of FCF trimming the count.
The current FY27 FCF yield is ~3.3% ($3.1B / $94B market cap). I allow slight expansion as the AI premium fades.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: FY28E revenue $12.7B x 8.5x = $108B EV less ~$5.7B net debt / 190M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: FY27 midpoint x 1.14, in line with the ~15% long-term CAGR target and ESD industry growth of about 13%.
Current EV/FY27 sales is ~9.1x ($101.2B / $11.15B) and CDNS trades at 16.7x trailing. I apply a mild de-rate.
$10.0B debt less $3.6B cash at Jul-26 (~$7.2B net per stockanalysis), reduced by retained FCF after buybacks.

bear.story: A repeat of the 2025 pattern: Design IP stalls again (an Intel Foundry/China/custom-silicon slip), Ansys growth slows, AI capex pauses in 2027 or EDA export controls return. FY27 EPS comes in around $17.5-18 and the multiple compresses to ~19x.

base.story: FY27 guide met or slightly beaten. The industry stays strong (TSMC N2 tape-outs, hyperscaler custom silicon, Cadence and Siemens EDA growing 18-30%). The market prices FY28 EPS of ~$23 at ~24-25x.

bull.story: AI agents (GPT-Synopsys, agentic flows) lift EDA consumption, Amazon-style license-plus-royalty IP deals spread to other hyperscalers, margins move toward 50% faster and the multiple re-rates toward CDNS at ~30x FY28 EPS of ~$24.

thesis_break_reason: $385 is about 20x the FY27 EPS guide and roughly where the stock sat in mid-September before the investor day. Trading back there would mean the market no longer believes the FY27 guide: most likely a new Design IP shortfall, renewed China EDA export restrictions, or a break in the AI silicon design cycle across the chain (TSMC, Cadence). Ordinary volatility alone should not get it there.

key_uncertainties: Durability of the Design IP recovery (Intel Foundry, China, custom silicon timing); the 2025 crash came from this segment
Whether AI capex and custom-silicon design starts hold up through 2027
Return of US export restrictions on EDA/IP to China, plus domestic substitution (Empyrean et al.)
Whether the 44% FY27 margin and the 50% FY30 target are achievable alongside Ansys integration
Multiple: SNPS sits at a large discount to CDNS. Convergence or further de-rating swings value by ±25%
Whether AI agents expand EDA consumption or put pressure on seat-based pricing over time
reasoning: Industry lane read: the whole EDA/IP chain is strong. The ESD Alliance shows industry revenue +12.7% YoY in Q1 2026. Cadence raised its 2026 guide to +19% with a record $8.1B backlog and IP +40%. Siemens EDA grew >30% in its Q3 FY26. TSMC raised its 2026 capex to $60-64B and reports 2nm tape-outs at 4x the N3 pace. Customer-side deals (the Amazon $1B+ license-plus-royalty IP pact, Intel 14A flow and IP certification, OpenAI GPT-Synopsys) back SNPS's FY27 guide of $11.15B revenue (+15%) and $19.08 EPS, about 8% above the prior Street EPS. Against that: SNPS's own IP segment only just returned to growth after the Sept 2025 collapse (a 36% one-day drop on an IP/Intel/China miss); China domestic EDA keeps growing but is still small (~RMB 2B combined); and export-control policy is binary. Valuation: at $490.54 the stock is ~25.7x FY27 guide versus CDNS at ~41x forward. Blending P/E, FCF yield and EV/sales gives a fair value of ~$562 for Oct 2027 (about +15%). Scenarios: bear $340 (20%), base $560 (55%), bull $720 (25%), mean ~$556. I built the ladder from a three-lognormal mixture (sigma 0.25 bear, 0.17 base and bull) and fattened the left tail slightly for the 45% realized vol and the 2025 precedent. The result is P(>=spot) of about 0.66 and a median of about $560. Twelve Data statistics and estimates endpoints were unavailable (plan limits), so valuation inputs come from company releases and stockanalysis.com. X/Twitter was not checked, and I found no relevant prediction market.
